subject: ML Ops guardrail reservation request: temporary dedicated slice for pilot ramp
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Internal Capacity <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: ML Ops guardrail reservation request for Helium pilot ramp

Team —

Quick ask: Helium.ai (pilot customer) confirmed expanded usage for their MLOps pilot starting 2028-01-10. They need predictable low-latency inference for a 4-week ramp (est. 120k GPU-minutes/week) and want a temporary dedicated slice with stricter autoscale guardrails (min nodes pinned, burst cap disabled).

Attachments: mlops_guardrail_request_v1.pdf (request + SLOs), q1_forecast_gpu_hours.csv

We discussed two options in product: (A) carve a temporary 2x A100-equivalent slice in the us-west pool and apply an autoscale exception to honor min capacity and a higher eviction grace window; or (B) route via Dedicated burst lanes but enforce reservation windows to prevent noisy-neighbor eviction.

Ask: Infra + Capacity team — can we approve option A as an exception for up to 5 weeks and produce a short runbook for on-call? Product needs a yes/no by EOD tomorrow so we can agree terms with Helium (they're requesting signed acknowledgement).

Thanks —
Marcus
Marcus Lin
Director, Product — Dedicated
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 30 Nov 2027 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: ML Ops guardrail reservation request for Helium pilot ramp

Marcus —

Thanks for the details. Option A is preferable from a reliability POV. A couple of points we need clarified before sign-off:

- Exact GPU SKU equivalence: are they asking for dedicated v100/a100 capacity? (the PDF lists A100-equivalent but we need the targeting profile for kernel selection).
- Autoscale exception duration: 5 weeks OK for Q1 pilot but ops will require pre-approved eviction grace (we typically set 30m; this ask is 4h). Need explicit rollback criteria.
- Billing/commit: will Helium accept a short-term reservation fee or do they expect credits?

Dev — can you outline the minimal runbook steps and whether we can enforce a policy to disable burst lanes for that slice?

If we get these answers I can scope the change request to Infra and Ops and schedule a quick risk review.

- Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of Product Ops
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Nov 2027 11:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: ML Ops guardrail reservation request for Helium pilot ramp

Quick tech note —

We can do a temporary slice that maps to two 80GB A100 logical units (what Marcus described). Implementation details:
- Lock min_nodes to 2 and set max_nodes to 6; disable burst scaling (no preemptible expansion).
- Increase eviction_grace to 4 hours for the reservation window.
- We'll need a short feature flag to prevent auto-preemption and a rollback toggle that ops can flip if other high-priority traffic appears.

Runbook outline (high-level):
1) Preflight: validate model artifact sizes and KV cache footprint.
2) Day 0: provision slice, run smoke + latency tests.
3) Monitoring: custom SLO dashboard + token-level cost alarms.
4) Incident flow: if latency > 2.5s p95 for 15m, scale to fallback model and notify CS.
5) Deprovision: revert feature flag, drain slice, and export usage.

I can draft the runbook and the small flag change. ETA: draft by EOD tomorrow.

- Dev
Senior Infra Engineer
From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Nov 2027 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: ML Ops guardrail reservation request for Helium pilot ramp

All —

I talked to Finance and Sales (looping Kimberly) about the billing angle. Kimberly, can you confirm whether Helium is comfortable with a short-term reservation charge or if they need a credits-based concession? We can do a one-off credit but need approval from Revenue Ops (takes ~48 hrs).

Operationally, I approve proceeding with Option A as a conditional exception:
- Duration: 2028-01-08 through 2028-02-12 (5 weeks including warmup/deprovision).
- Slice profile: 2x A100-equivalent logical units, min_nodes=2, max_nodes=6, burst disabled.
- Eviction grace: 4 hours.
- Preflight: Dev to deliver runbook and smoke test results at least 72 hrs prior to provision.

I'll prepare the exception ticket and update the dedicated policy doc. Please get the runbook and finalized billing language into this thread so I can attach them.

Thanks —
Olga
Capacity Programs Manager
From: Helium.ai <ops@helium.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 1 Dec 2027 09:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: ML Ops guardrail reservation request for Helium pilot ramp

Hi Olga / team —

Thanks for the quick coordination and for outlining Option A. We can accept a short-term reservation charge; please propose the fee and we will confirm. A few clarifications from our side:

- We need a runbook page we can reference for escalation (CS/ops contact).
- Can the eviction grace be enforced even if we hit platform-level emergency reclaim? We need an explicit guarantee that we won't be preempted during our scheduled window except for security incidents.
- We'll share a final load forecast tomorrow morning.

If you draft the reservation terms (price, start/end, rollback triggers) we'll get legal to ack.

Best,
Priya Rana
Ops Lead, Helium.ai
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Helium.ai <ops@helium.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: ML Ops guardrail reservation request for Helium pilot ramp

Thanks Priya —

We will send proposed reservation terms today (pricing + start/end + rollback triggers). Quick answers:
- Eviction guarantees: we can commit to no platform-initiated preemption for the slice during the reservation window except in the case of confirmed/severe security incidents and major region outages; we'll document precise triggers in the terms.
- Billing: we'll issue a short-term reservation invoice; Helium can request a credit memo but that requires Revenue Ops sign-off (typically 48-72 hrs).

Olga — I'll attach the draft terms and the invoice template in the next email. Dev — if you can post the runbook draft to the shared doc link linked below, we can attach it to the customer terms.

Regards,
Kimberly Park
Head of Revenue Operations
